text.p: Tropical storm Marco is still moving very little in the Caribbean. It is of most concern to shipping and boating in the area about 160 miles south-southeast of Kingston Jamaica. Eventually it is expected to drift to just off the south coast of Jamaica, later this weekend. This should bring heavy rain and wind to Jamaica, likely causing flooding and possibly causing mudslides. Please note..Marco has been difficult to forecast during the past couple of days. Strength and direction have both been erratic. Anyone with interests in Hispanola, Jamaica, Cuba and the southeast Bahamas islands should keep an eye on the latest with tropical storm Marco.
THERE ARE NO FURTHER EMERGENCY WEATHER STATEMENTS
